decision: The retained byte-verified engine is a reuse candidate when activation is authorized; reviewed source recognizes large-v3 and supports -f - stdin. Its binary-to-source provenance, current companion selection and actual full-v3 runtime compatibility still need acceptance. Current base weights remain separately protected and do not qualify as full-v3.
companion_boundary: The current companion verifies an engine hash declared in its own private config and only checks the declared source revision's shape; it does not independently bind that config to this recorded binary or prove checked-byte continuity. See WHISPER-ENGINE-BOUNDARY.md.
observed_transport_issue: Actual Android public child cannot reopen inherited anonymous input via /proc/self/fd/N; pipe stdin succeeds. Companion0.2.1 source changes audio to stdin and uses fixed authored schema beside executable for the path-only Codex flag.
runtime_acceptance: Not achieved. Engine was hashed, not executed. No inference, microphone, model download, installation, controller or keyboard change.
